verdict.rationale: Ashby's developer docs include a dedicated webhook setup guide for real-time notifications on events such as candidate status changes, job posting updates and interview scheduling. Payloads can be signed with a secret token and verified via the `Ashby-Signature` header. missing for 10: a complete catalog of event types, documented retry/delivery guarantees, evidence of programmatic (API-based) webhook subscription management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
